    <title>A note on hardness of promise hypergraph colouring</title>
    <updated>2022-05-29T17:11:23Z</updated>
    <link href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.14719v1" rel="alternate" type="text/html"/>
    <link href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2205.14719v1" rel="related" type="application/pdf" title="pdf"/>
    <summary>We show a slightly simpler proof the following theorem by I. Dinur, O. Regev, and C. Smyth: for all $c \geq 2$, it is NP-hard to find a $c$-colouring of a 2-coloruable 3-uniform hypergraph. We recast this result in the algebraic framework for Promise CSPs, using only a weaker version of the PCP theorem.</summary>
